// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the key.
User* (xref:#entidad-user[User])::
User who owns the key; requests made with it act on behalf of this user.
Name* (string)::
A label to identify the key (e.g. 'CI pipeline', 'local dev').
Key hash* (string)::
Digest (HMAC with pepper) of the raw key. Never stored in plain text.
Scopes* (string)::
Space-separated OAuth scopes granted to this key.
Last used at (datetime)::
Timestamp of the most recent successful authentication.
Expires at (datetime)::
Optional expiry. Null means the key does not expire.
Created at* (datetime)::
When the key was created.
Enabled* (boolean)::
A disabled key is rejected, without deleting it.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de user personal api key para controlar bloqueos optimistas
